text: 药物使用频率高。因华法林联合抗菌药物所导致的出血等不良事件被频繁报道。本文对华法林和抗菌药物的相互作用及其机制的研究进展作一综述，为指导临床合理用药提供参考，以减少不良事件的发生。( 1． 中南大学湘雅三医院临床药理中心，长沙410013;2． 中南大学湘雅医学院，长沙410013)YU Jing － jing1 ，KUANG Yun1 ，WANG Hai2 ，YANG Guo － ping1 Abstract: Warfarin is the most common oral anticoagulant for the management of diseases such as atrial fibrillation and deep venous thrombosis. Warfarin has a narrow therapeutic range and dramatic interpatient variability，and may interact with many drugs. Patients with these diseases are usually elderly patients who are prone to infection and have a high frequency of antibiotics use. Adverse events like bleeding resulted from the combination of warfarin and antibiotics have been frequently reported. This review will summarize the progresses on the interactions between warfarin and antibiotics as well as the mechanisms with an attempt to provide a reference for clinical rational drug use and decrease adverse events.( 1． Center of Clinical Pharmacology， The Third Xiangya Hospital of Central South University， Changsha 410013， China;
